properties.title: Tens of thousands march in Brussels demanding urgent climate action
properties.summary: Tens of thousands of people marched through Brussels on Sunday, 11 October, demanding stronger action on climate change ahead of next month's COP31 summit in Antalya, Turkey.

properties.title: Turkey bans social media for kids under 15
properties.summary: The government of Turkey on Saturday formally banned access to social media platform for children under the age of 15. The law was published today following the Turkish Parliament’s adoption of the bill last April. The ban will come into force on Nov. 1. Social media platforms will have to “take the necessary technical and administrative measures, including age verification,” to implement the new rules, the law states.
